title: Universal Robots UR10e + Robotiq 2F-85
world: table 1.2 x 1.2 m, top z = 0 (robot base on it), floor z = -0.75; box 50 mm 0.1 kg, cylinder r 30 x 100 mm 0.15 kg, T14's recorded mug (library/robots/task_t14, convex pieces, 0.404 kg)
changes: visual-only geoms and their meshes, materials and textures dropped

source keyframes dropped; keyframe 'init' = start state (robot start pose, ctrl = its joint targets, objects at rest), both clipped into the joint ranges; free-floating robots lifted so the deepest floor contact just touches
collision hulls above 64 vertices split into convex pieces within 0.2 mm (hull_split.json)

robot self-pairs overlapping > 0.5 mm at the start pose, or at qpos0 (where alloy.build starts a robot), excluded: H1-2's wrist yaw | thumb proximal, each hand; the Franka arms' link5 | hand (Panda) or link7 (FR3), whose hulls overlap 5.6-43 mm at qpos0 and 15-33 mm at joint6's lower limit; none elsewhere
options: jacobian sparse; <flag multiccd="disable"/> written out (Alloy's MJCF route, as for T12: Newton reads an absent flag as off, MuJoCo as on; explicit, both read off)

robot geoms (every link, the hand or gripper base, fingers and pads): solref -> [0.0025, 1.0] (from MuJoCo's default 0.02 s; the 2F-85's pads from 0.004 s; 2 x the 1.25 ms robot step) and solmix 1 -> 1000, so the robot's solref governs a pair with the 0.02 s table, floor or an object. At MuJoCo's default 0.02 s the 15 g Franka finger rested 5.5 mm deep at 91 N and an arm pressing on its table went INVALID (TRAIN-FIX 1b; the team root cause, an outside test F1). The world's table, floor, box and cylinder: solref 0.02 -> 0.0025 too (solmix 1): with the table at 0.02 s the hand pressed a 4 cm cube 11.8 mm into it. Both, where solimp was MuJoCo's default 0.9 0.95 0.001: solimp -> [0.95, 0.99, 0.001] (the 2F-85 pads' and the mug's), half the steady press depth. Friction and condim unchanged (alloy.tasks.emb_firm)
